findings.text: The filter `if kw.arg is not None` silently drops **kwargs unpacking in factory call strings. Input like `create_app(**{'debug': True})` will call `create_app()` with no arguments, ignoring user-specified configuration without any error.

0.reason: The `if kw.arg is not None` filter silently drops `**`-unpacking entries (where `kw.arg` is `None` in the AST), causing factory calls like `create_app(**{'debug': True})` to be invoked with no arguments.
